source: https://www.openstreetmap.org (boundary=administrative relations inside Turkmenistan at admin_level 4: five provinces (welaýat) and the city of Ashgabat; name = the OSM name tag as gazetteer.py reads it, so that board candidates and lookups share one spelling)
_meta.note: Five provinces and the city of Ashgabat, all first-level divisions at OSM admin_level 4; code = ISO 3166-2:TM. gazetteer.py cuts the OSM name tag 'Daşoguz welaýaty' to 'Daşoguz' (the name:* value that is its prefix), so the table uses the short Turkmen names. Arkadag, the capital of Ahal Province and a 'city of state importance' since 2023, is not a separate OSM relation at this level and lies inside Ahal.
